tr-riis.description: Three old friends. The President, Bishop Vincent and Jacob Riis taken at Chautauqua NY, August 11th 1905 - Photo shows President Roosevelt, Bishop Vincent, and Jacob Riis, full-length portrait, facing front, standing at the entrance to a brick building at Chautauqua. Creator: Underwood & Underwood. Date: 1905
tr-riis.collection: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-riis.credit_line: "Three old friends" - Jacob Riis, President Roosevelt and Bishop John H. Vincent at the entrance to Higgins Memorial Hall, Chautauqua, New York, 11 August 1905. Photograph by Underwood & Underwood. Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division.
tr-riis.note: Identification corroborated by a second record: Houghton/DAM asset 961d02bf-9567-4451-a745-264f92db90d2, har_4419540_T_R_with_Bishop_Vincent_and_Jacob_Riis.jpg, which gives the sitters left to right as Jacob Riis, Theodore Roosevelt and John H. Vincent at Higgins Memorial Hall, Chautauqua, photographed by Underwood & Underwood, dated 1905 August 11. Both records name the same three men, the same photographer and the same date. The men are STANDING in long dark coats and top hats, not seated in summer suits - an earlier alt text said otherwise and was wrong.
